page.overview:
Who is Tarciryan?

Tarciryan was the son of King Siriondil of Gondor, the younger brother of Tarannon, and the father of Eärnil I. When his elder brother died without an heir, his son ascended the throne.

Tarciryan was presumably born after the year 654 of the Third Age, the year of his elder brother Tarannon's birth. In the year 736, Tarciryan became the father of Eärnil I. Tarciryan's father, died and his brother Tarannon became King of Gondor. When Tarannon died without an heir in the year 913, the throne passed directly to Tarciryan's son, Eärnil I.

Tarciryan is a Quenya name with an untold meaning, though J. E. A. Tyler suggested in that it meant "Royal-ships", while Robert Foster suggested in that it meant "lord-ship". Paul Strack suggests on Eldamo that it may be a compound of tar ("high") and ciryando ("sailer") meaning "high sailer". Alternatively, Mark Fisher suggests on The Encyclopedia of Arda that "lord of ships" or "Captain of Ships" may be a translation of Tarciryan. [https://lotro-wiki.com/wiki/User:Varghedin Varghedin], a user on wiki, suggests that "high-ship" might be the meaning.

In , Tarciryan is mentioned on a plaque dedicated to Eärnil I Ciryatan in the Workers' Tier of Minas Tirith.
